Study context:
Study ID: ART_00790

Participants:
292 participants (intervention 119; control 173)

Pregnant women with:

* Undergoing a caesarean birth (emergency or elective not stated).

Methods:
| Characteristic     | Description                             |

Oxytocin was administered intravenously postoperatively to enhance uterine involution.
* **Control:** Caesarean section
